clue.text: Arrives carrying papers and concentrates

indicators.note: one word carrying another holds it inside, so the first word is opened up around the second

parts.note: the papers, collectively the newspapers, are the press

explanation.surface: Someone turns up with newspapers and gets down to serious focus.
explanation.definitionFit: To concentrate something is to squeeze it into less space, a synonym verb.

clue.text: Bad language used in employing a coat hanger

indicators.note: the phrase employing the letters means they are held within its run of words, spanning a word break

explanation.surface: Swearing occurs while someone struggles with a coat hanger.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters sit across 'coat' and 'hanger'; 'used in' is just link material.
explanation.definitionFit: A curse or swear word is bad language, one sense of the noun.

clue.text: Fails in a test for marks of rank

definitions.meaning: old British slang: to pip a candidate is to fail him in an examination
the small stars on an army officer's shoulder showing rank

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses share one spelling: an old exam slang verb and the shoulder stars on a British officer's uniform.

clue.text: Comes after although the United Nations sees differently

indicators.note: seeing things differently signals that these letters are to be arranged in another order

parts.note: UN is the abbreviation for the United Nations

explanation.surface: Something follows even though the UN takes another view.
explanation.definitionFit: To follow on as a consequence is what a result does, a synonym verb.

clue.text: Objecting to the psychiatrist, but it does wash!

definitions.meaning: a shrink is slang for a psychiatrist, and objecting to one is being opposed to him
describes a fabric that survives laundering without getting smaller

explanation.surface: A patient who will not see the therapist, yet the shirt survives the laundry.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes a garment that keeps its size in water, and literally a person opposing a therapist.

clue.text: Lying on her back a girl is without something to fix her clothes

indicators.note: here without means outside, so the girl's name goes around the other piece

explanation.surface: A woman lies on her back, short of a pin to fasten her outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' is used in its older sense of outside, not lacking; 'is without' wraps the girl's name around the fastener.
explanation.definitionFit: Face upward and flat is the exact posture the adjective names.

clue.text: Helps me when involved with the bad and accursed

indicators.note: letters involved with one another are tangled up, so these are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: A plea for help gets mixed up with wicked, damned matters.
explanation.definitionFit: To curse something profanely is to speak impiously of it, so accursed and spoken against sacredly overlap.

clue.text: I play the part of a novice and people adore me

parts.note: to do a role is to play it, as in doing Hamlet
L is a learner, as on British L-plates for learner drivers

explanation.surface: A beginner actor boasts of being worshipped.
explanation.definitionFit: An object of worship is what fans adore, a description rather than a synonym.

clue.text: Resolves to stop means of production

parts.note: to deter is to stop someone acting

explanation.surface: Someone resolves to halt the factories.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle or decide is to fix firmly, a synonym verb.

clue.text: Writing formed from pretty pictures in miniature

indicators.note: something formed from these letters is made by rearranging them

parts.note: pics is the shortened form of pictures

explanation.surface: Text made out of tiny decorative pictures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pictures in miniature' gives PICS, which 'formed from' shuffles with PRETTY.
explanation.definitionFit: A typed document is a piece of text produced on a machine, a specific kind of written matter.

clue.text: Woman who has her place in the heart of selfish people

indicators.note: the heart of a word is what is left with the outer letters cut away

explanation.surface: A woman knows her station is amid self-centred folk.
explanation.walkthrough: Strip two letters from each end of EGOTISTS to leave its middle four.
explanation.definitionFit: The name of a lady, as in Cole Porter's song about a Miss of that surname who regrets.

clue.text: Posh part of shoe caught by girl

parts.note: the upper is the top part of a shoe
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A girl grabs the fancy top of a shoe.
explanation.definitionFit: Aristocratic or smart, the informal adjective for people of high social standing.

clue.text: Range provided by writer which the muses follow

indicators.note: the second piece follows the first, so it is placed after it

parts.note: a pen is something to write with
the Muses of Greek myth were nine sisters

explanation.surface: A writer is followed by inspiring goddesses.
explanation.walkthrough: The Pennines are a range of hills running down northern England.
explanation.definitionFit: A chain of hills in northern England, an example of a mountain range.

clue.text: Rattle on about old boy being concerned with will

indicators.note: one word about another surrounds it

parts.note: to prate is to chatter on idly
OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil

explanation.surface: An old schoolboy chatters on about a legacy.
explanation.definitionFit: Proving a dead person's testament in court is the legal process of establishing a valid estate document.

clue.text: Wide area of water where vessels are in the river

indicators.note: the vessels are in the river, so its letters go around them

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon, south-west England

explanation.surface: Boats float on a broad stretch of river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vessels' looks like boats, but it means cooking pans.
explanation.definitionFit: A broad open stretch, as of sea or sky, is a wide sweep of space.

clue.text: Covers walls with lots of questions

definitions.meaning: to paper a room is to hang wallpaper on it
exam sheets set with many questions

explanation.definitionFit: One word is both a decorating verb and the plural of exam sheets.

clue.text: Daily to follow for sport

parts.note: to chase is to follow in pursuit

explanation.surface: A newspaper is chased for fun.
explanation.definitionFit: A hare-and-hounds running game where a trail of shreds is laid, an outdoor pastime.

clue.text: Church dignitary discovers cross in unstarted quest

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other
a word unstarted loses its first letter

explanation.surface: A senior cleric finds a crucifix during a search.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unstarted' drops the S of SEARCH to give EARCH, which then holds X.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop of high rank in the Eastern churches, a type of ecclesiastical official.

clue.text: Give me brainy priests for conversion to this religion

indicators.note: conversion changes the form of these letters, rearranging them

explanation.surface: Clever clergy are asked to convert someone to their faith.
explanation.definitionFit: A Protestant church system governed by elders, a form of Christian belief.

clue.text: Read part of London into the ceremony

indicators.note: one piece goes into another

parts.note: EC is the postal district of East Central London, the City

explanation.surface: A London district is written into a formal ritual.
explanation.definitionFit: To speak a text aloud from memory or a page, a synonym of reading out.

clue.text: Royal currency needed for mission

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the royal cipher
the rand is the currency of South Africa

explanation.surface: Royal money is required for a task.
explanation.definitionFit: A short trip to do a job is a small task or assignment.

clue.text: Get up when the dances go crazy

indicators.note: letters that go crazy are thrown into a wild new arrangement

explanation.surface: People rise to their feet when the dancing turns frantic.
explanation.definitionFit: To rise or climb is a synonym verb for getting up.

clue.text: Is of service when a verse is not fit

explanation.surface: Poetry helps when one is feeling poorly.
explanation.definitionFit: To help or be of use, a synonym verb.

clue.text: A cockney got up about four and was inclined to wear out

parts.note: a cockney drops his aitches, so he becomes 'E

indicators.note: one piece wraps around the other

parts.note: IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A Londoner rose around four and was fit to drop.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockneys drop H, so 'he' is 'E. ROSE goes about IV.
explanation.definitionFit: Tending to wear something away gradually, as water does rock.

clue.text: Consumption of energy needed in race

definitions.meaning: warmth is energy that is used up when burned

explanation.definitionFit: Warmth as burned energy and a preliminary round of a race share one spelling.

clue.text: Woman with two degrees

indicators.note: two calls for the piece to be given twice

parts.note: MA is a Master of Arts degree

explanation.surface: A woman holds a pair of qualifications.
explanation.definitionFit: A mother is a woman, and this is a childish word for one.

clue.text: Look upwards to practise conservatism

indicators.note: in a down clue upwards means the letters run bottom to top, read in reverse

explanation.surface: Glancing upward is a way to stay conservative.
explanation.definitionFit: To retain or preserve things unchanged is the essence of conserving.

clue.text: Office in which one has a language in one's head

indicators.note: the office is that in which the head holds the other pieces, so they go inside it

explanation.surface: A clerk's office where someone has a foreign tongue in mind.
explanation.definitionFit: The rank or territory of a count palatine, a jurisdiction or office of state.

clue.text: Something to wear which may be seen in the window

definitions.meaning: a band of cloth worn over the shoulder or waist

definitions.text: may be seen in the window
definitions.meaning: a sliding frame in a ... window

explanation.definitionFit: A worn band and a sliding window frame share one spelling.

clue.text: An experiment in moistures gives signs of time

indicators.note: one piece goes in the other

explanation.surface: A trial with damp conditions shows the passage of time.
explanation.definitionFit: Ink marks recording a day on documents are indicators of when.
